# Hojari

> Hojari builds websites and apps that work while you don’t. It is a one-person studio run by Prejith Ponnachan, for small businesses anywhere in the world, from Muscat, Oman. It builds websites and the tools behind them: online booking, quotes and invoices, online ordering, client portals and owner dashboards. Fixed prices, and clients try a working version on their own business for 7 days before paying anything.

Hojari is named after the top grade of Omani frankincense. It is not a frankincense seller. All work happens online, by video call, WhatsApp and email. Contact: hello@hojari.co.uk, or the form at https://hojari.co.uk/#contact. About Prejith: https://hojari.co.uk/about/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/hojari/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hojari.uk/ Trustpilot: https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/hojari.co.uk

## Plans (fixed prices, shown in pounds; the site also shows US dollars, euros, Australian and Canadian dollars and UAE dirhams)

- [Website (Silver)](https://hojari.co.uk/prices/): from £750, then £49 a month for care. A website of up to 8 pages plus one tool, such as booking, quotes, ordering or instant WhatsApp replies. A working version within 7 days of receiving words and photos.
- [Website Plus (Royal Green)](https://hojari.co.uk/prices/): from £1,950, then £99 a month for care. Everything in Silver, plus up to three tools sharing one set of customer records, and an owner's dashboard.
- [Your own app (Signature)](https://hojari.co.uk/prices/): from £3,950, then £149 a month for care. A custom app, client portal or platform, with a website to match.
- [The one-week fix](https://hojari.co.uk/prices/): from £450, then £29 a month for care. One tool that takes a job off the owner's hands, working within 7 days on the website they already have.

## Promises

- Free to try for 7 days before paying.
- A reply within one working day.
- A working version within 7 days of receiving words and photos, or 14 days for bigger tools. The client tries it for 7 days, then pays and it goes live.
- Before the build, up to three numbers are agreed in writing (such as software and commission costs, admin hours, reply time, or online bookings and orders). They are measured again 30 days after launch; if none has improved, the build fee is refunded.
- The free 7-day trial is one per business, and the working version stays on a private link until the client pays.
- The domain, words, photos and customer data are in the client's name, and the code is theirs once the build is paid.
